name: Oblitosaurus
sum: A large basal ankylopollexian ornithopod from the Late Jurassic Villar del Arzobispo Formation of Spain, the largest ornithopod of its time in Europe.
wsnote: Estimated at 6-7 m long, larger than Camptosaurus and Draconyx.
holotype: A dentary tooth (CPT-1440), a left thumb claw (CPT-1444) and an almost complete left hindlimb (MAP-8290 to MAP-8299).
material: Same elements; large footprints from the area may also belong to it.
biology: Not described in the sources consulted beyond its large size.
author: Sánchez-Fenollosa et al. 2023

sources.text: Sánchez-Fenollosa, Sergio; Verdú, Francisco; Cobos, Alberto 2023.
